2.0.77._note: Captured on Factorio 2.0.77 from the release/2.0 recut at 0.2.1, which is the only place it can be taken: guest/go/data/engine.go keys on the RUNNING engine, so a 2.1 binary produces the 2.1 flavour whatever the manifest says. What this line pins that the 2.1.16 one cannot is the three things the version branch turns ON -- `not_colliding_with_itself` on bbb-linked-belt's collision mask, the `bbb-can-stack` marker prototype, and a mod-settings dump carrying the runtime-global `bbb-multi-edge-parts` beside the two startup cost settings, where the 2.1 arm carries the two alone. Per engine and per mod set: the dump carries every prototype every mod defined. Only the DEFAULT settings are hashed; the variant and speed arms assert values.
